summary.text: Stephen Latham is a Democratic candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the August 18, 2026 Democratic primary, and Ballotpedia's campaign finance records list a 2022 campaign for the same district that he lost in the general election.
